snippet.title: Game Boy Longplay [261] Fish Dude
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: RickyC

I played many a flash game that had a similar premise so I thought i'd check out how it was on the game boy. It's still relatively fun but misses out on the real time growth of the fish to make it more similar to pac-man. -
